name: Modal
description: A dialog over the page that blocks interaction until dismissed. Prefer the native <dialog> element.

elements.name: backdrop
elements.description: Dimmed layer behind the dialog; clicking it may close the modal.

elements.name: header
elements.description: Holds the title and close button.

elements.name: close
elements.description: Icon button that closes the dialog.

elements.name: footer
elements.description: Actions, right-aligned. Put the primary action last.

states.name: closed
states.description: Hidden. Remove the attribute (or set another value) to show the modal.
states.pair: When closed, return focus to the control that opened the modal.

children: c-modal contains c-modal__backdrop and c-modal__container as siblings.
c-modal__container contains header, body and footer in that order.

use: Use for short, focused tasks: confirmations, small forms.
Buttons in c-modal__footer are c-button; the footer provides the gap.
avoid: Opening a modal from another modal.
Long, scrolling content; use a page instead.

a11y: Set role="dialog" (or use <dialog>), aria-modal="true" and aria-labelledby pointing at c-modal__title.
Move focus into the modal when it opens and trap it until it closes.
